standard_prerequisites.name: Left-invariant C-star subalgebras of the bounded right-uniformly continuous functions and their spectra
standard_prerequisites.statement: For a topological group the article considers the unital, left-invariant, closed C-star subalgebras of the algebra of bounded right-uniformly continuous functions, the flow of the group on the spectrum of such an algebra, and the finite colorings that belong to the algebra, so that a finite coloring is exactly the kind of element whose topological behaviour the flow records. The author's own definitions are the ones used by the counted statement and proof.
standard_prerequisites.use: The counted proposition is the general statement that ties a fixed point of this flow to the Ramsey property of the structure for the colorings that lie in the algebra.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite oscillation stability and its equivalent Ramsey form
standard_prerequisites.statement: A finite family of functions is finitely oscillation stable when for every finite set of group elements and every precision there is a point at which all the functions in the family vary by less than the precision; the article's oscillation stability proposition states that for a finite set of finite colorings this is equivalent to finding, for every finite substructure, a copy of it on which every coloring of the family is constant. The author's own definitions and the surrounding results are the ones used by the counted statement and proof.
standard_prerequisites.use: The proof uses the equivalent forms in both directions: the fixed point is first translated into finite oscillation stability, and the combinatorial form of that property is then recognised as the Ramsey property.

core_obligations: Forward direction: apply the article's fixed point proposition, which gives that the flow has a fixed point if and only if every finite family in the algebra is finitely oscillation stable (source line 387).

Transfer along density: because finite colorings are dense in the algebra, the condition for every finite family is the same as the condition for every finite set of finite colorings (source line 387).

Recognise the combinatorial form: by the article's oscillation stability proposition, finite oscillation stability of a finite set of finite colorings is equivalent to the existence, for every finite substructure, of a copy of it on which every coloring of the set is constant (source line 387).
Conclude: that last condition is exactly the Ramsey property of the structure for the colorings in the algebra, which proves the equivalence (source line 387).

proof_roadmap.step: Use the fixed point proposition to rewrite the existence of a fixed point as finite oscillation stability of every finite family in the algebra.
Replace arbitrary finite families by finite sets of finite colorings, using that finite colorings are dense in the algebra.
Identify the resulting condition with the Ramsey property through the oscillation stability proposition, which closes the equivalence.

difficulty_reason: 计数单元是 doi:10.5802/ahl.16 的 Proposition cor:fpRP（源 378-384 行，证明 386-388 行）：设 F 是 Fraïssé 结构、A 是 RUCB(Aut(F)) 的单位、左不变、闭 C*-子代数且有限着色在 A 中稠密，则「流 Aut(F)↷Aut(F)^A 有不动点」⇔「F 对 A 中的着色有 Ramsey 性质」。证明不是例行核验，而是**三步等价链**：①用同章不动点命题把「有不动点」改写成「A 中每个有限族有限振荡稳定」；②用**有限着色在 A 中稠密**把「每个有限族」收窄为「每个有限着色的有限集」——这一步是整条链的枢纽，分析侧的稠密性在此被换成组合侧的有限族；③用振荡稳定命题的组合形式把那条件认成「对每个有限子结构都存在使其上每个着色为常数的拷贝」，即 Ramsey 性质。难点在把分析侧的不动点条件经稠密性降为组合侧的常数条件，且两步引用的方向都不能反。原文位置全在证明的 387 行。
